eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Age requirement
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants aged ≥18 at the time of signing the ICF.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Wilson Disease diagnosis
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Diagnosis of WD by Leipzig Criteria ≥ 4 documented by testing as outlined in the 2012 European Association for the Study of Liver WD Clinical Practice Guidelines (Ferenci, 2003; EASL, 2012) or by historical test results for WD including some or all of the following: Presence of Kayser Fleischer rings, Neurological symptoms, Serum ceruloplasmin below reference range, Coombs_negative hemolytic anemia, Elevated liver or urinary copper, Presence of mutations in the ATP7B gene, or Other, as considered appropriate, may be used instead to confirm the diagnosis of WD.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Benefit from decoppering therapy
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants who in the opinion of the referring Investigator may benefit from decoppering therapy.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Ability to comply with study procedures
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants must be able to comply with all study_related procedures.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Ability to reside in CRU
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants must be able to reside in the CRU for intensive metabolic monitoring of copper and molybdenum.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Willingness to discontinue chelator therapy
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants willing to discontinue chelator therapy for approximately 4 days prior to initiation of ALXN1840 to allow a baseline assessment of copper balance.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Adequate venous access
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants with adequate venous access to allow collection of required blood samples.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Ability to swallow tablets
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants must be able to swallow intact ALXN1840 tablets.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Willingness to avoid copper/zinc/molybdenum minerals
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants willing to avoid use of minerals containing copper, zinc, or molybdenum throughout the study duration.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Willingness to adhere to controlled diet
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants willing to adhere to copper/molybdenum_controlled diet during inpatient periods and willing to comply with a low copper dietary requirement during the Outpatient Period.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Contraceptive use requirement
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Contraceptive use by men or women should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. Male participants: Male participants, if heterosexually active and with a female spouse or partner of childbearing potential or a pregnant or breastfeeding spouse or partner, must agree to use barrier contraception (male condom) for the duration of the study and for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Male participants must not donate sperm for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female spouses or partners of male participants who are of childbearing potential must use highly effective contraception as defined in Section 10.4, starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before (the male participant's) first study intervention administration and continuing until at least 3 months after the end of their male partner's systemic exposure to the study intervention. Barrier contraception (male condom) is required even with documented medical assessment of surgical success of a vasectomy. For male participants who have had a vasectomy (with documented evidence of azoospermia if possible) and agree to use a male condom for the stated time period, no additional contraceptive method is required by their female partner. Female participants: Female participants or female partners of male participants of childbearing potential (including breastfeeding females), if heterosexually active, must be willing to follow protocol_specified contraception guidance starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before first study intervention administration and continuing for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants must not donate ova for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants who are documented as being of non_childbearing potential as defined in Section 10.4 are exempt from contraception requirements.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Informed consent capability
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants capable of giving signed informed consent, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Decompensated cirrhosis or high MELD score
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Decompensated cirrhosis or model for end_stage liver disease (MELD) score > 13.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: High modified Nazer score
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Modified Nazer score > 7 (Dhawan, 2005).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent gastrointestinal bleed
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Clinically significant gastrointestinal bleed within past 3 months.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Elevated ALT
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) > 2 × upper limit of normal (ULN).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Marked neurological disease
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Marked neurological disease requiring assistance with self_care or activities of daily life.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Low hemoglobin
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Hemoglobin less than lower limit of the reference range for age and sex.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Active viral infection or HIV seropositivity
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Active infection with hepatitis B virus (positive hepatitis B surface antigen) or C virus (participants with positive hepatitis C antibody result would require confirmation of active disease with a positive hepatitis C polymerase chain reaction test), or seropositivity for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Significant medical history or current disorder
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: History or presence of/significant history of or current cardiovascular, respiratory, hepatic, renal, gastrointestinal, endocrinological, hematological, or neurological disorders, or psychiatric disorder that in the opinion of the Investigator may constitute a risk when taking the study intervention; or may interfere with the interpretation of data.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Prior ALXN1840 or tetrathiomolybdate treatment
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Previous treatment with ALXN1840 or other form of tetrathiomolybdate within 1 year prior to dosing.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Prior zinc treatment
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Previous treatment with zinc within 21 days prior to Day 1.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent experimental or unapproved therapy
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: The use of an experimental or unapproved/unlicensed therapy at the same time or within 90 days or 5 half_lives, whichever is longer, prior to the Screening Visit.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Renal failure
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants in renal failure, defined as in end_stage renal disease on dialysis (chronic kidney disease [CKD] stage 5) or creatinine clearance < 30 mL/min (Levey, 2006).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Pregnancy or breastfeeding
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Pregnant (or females who are planning to become pregnant) or breastfeeding females (women of childbearing potential must have a negative serum pregnancy test result at screening).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840 or excipients
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840, ALXN1840 excipients (anhydrous dicalcium phosphate, anhydrous sodium carbonate), or any of the ingredients contained in ALXN1840 or related compounds.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Likely non_compliance or uncooperativeness
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: In the opinion of the Investigator, the participant and/or their legal guardian is likely to be non_compliant or uncooperative during the study.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: History of illicit drug or significant alcohol abuse
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: History of illicit drug abuse, history of significant alcohol abuse within 1 year prior to the Screening Visit, or clinical evidence of substance and/or alcohol abuse within the 2 years before screening. Alcohol abuse is defined as regular weekly intake of more than 14 units (for both males and females), using the following National Health Service (NHS) alcohol tracker http://www.nhs.uk/Tools/Pages/drinks_tracker.aspx.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Positive urine drug toxicology screen
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day _8 (cannabinoids will not be tested).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent alcohol consumption or positive alcohol breath test
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Alcohol consumption within 48 hours prior to study intervention administration or positive alcohol breath test at screening or on Day _8.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Unwillingness to complete every meal and tolerate controlled menu
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study.

substance.name: bis_choline tetrathiomolybdate
substance.description: Active pharmaceutical ingredient of ALXN1840; formerly known as WTX101. Each 15 mg ALXN1840 tablet contains 7.8 mg of tetrathiomolybdic acid as the active anion tetrathiomolybdate.

medicalDevices.name: Intravenous Cannula
medicalDevices.label: IV Cannula
medicalDevices.description: Cannula placed to minimize needle sticks for repeated blood draws for PK/PD sampling; may not be left in place for longer than 72 hours and should be flushed a minimum of every 8 hours

medicalDevices.name: Automated Blood Pressure Device
medicalDevices.label: Automated BP Monitor
medicalDevices.description: Completely automated device used for blood pressure and heart rate measurements; manual techniques used only if automated device is not available

medicalDevices.name: 12_Lead ECG Device
medicalDevices.label: ECG Machine
medicalDevices.description: Device used to perform triplicate 12_lead electrocardiograms to assess heart rate and cardiac intervals (PR, QRS, QT, QTcF); ECG printed at time of collection for review

medicalDevices.name: Large Water Bottle Dispenser
medicalDevices.label: Water Dispenser
medicalDevices.description: Shared large water bottle dispenser from which all participants drink during inpatient periods; water samples collected and analyzed for copper and molybdenum content

arms.name: ALXN1840 Treatment
arms.description: All participants receive ALXN1840 with dose titration starting at 15 mg/day for approximately 28 days, followed by titration up to 30 mg/day on Day 29 through Day 39/40. Single_arm, open_label, repeat_dose study.

objectives.name: Primary Copper Balance Objective
objectives.text: Assess net copper balance with daily repeat_dose ALXN1840 treatment (15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with Wilson disease (WD)

endpoints.name: Primary Copper Balance Endpoint
endpoints.text: Mean daily copper balance where copper balance is measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady_state periods for each dose

objectives.name: Secondary Copper Balance Change Objective
objectives.text: Assess change in copper balance in response to ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day during ALXN1840 accumulation and at steady state periods versus the pretreatment baseline in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Copper Balance Change Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change in mean daily copper balance as measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) from pretreatment baseline (Days _4 through _1) and ALXN1840 accumulation and steady_state periods for each dose

endpoints.name: Safety Endpoint _ Clinical Laboratory Assessments
endpoints.text: Clinical laboratory assessments (serum chemistry, hematology, coagulation, and urinalysis)

objectives.name: Secondary Copper Disposition Objective
objectives.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 (15 mg/day and 30 mg/day) on the disposition of copper in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Copper Disposition Endpoint
endpoints.text: Copper quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, including plasma total and labile bound copper (LBC) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady_state periods for each dose

objectives.name: Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Objective
objectives.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 on the disposition of molybdenum at steady state at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Endpoint
endpoints.text: Molybdenum quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, plasma total molybdenum at ALXN1840 steady state

endpoints.name: Safety Endpoint _ ECG
endpoints.text: Heart rate, intervals (PR, QRS, QT and QTc), and clinically significant electrocardiogram (ECG) findings as determined by triplicate 12_lead ECG

objectives.name: Secondary Molybdenum Balance Objective
objectives.text: Assess steady_state total molybdenum balance as a measure of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Molybdenum Balance Endpoint
endpoints.text: Mean daily molybdenum balance as demonstrated through measurement of molybdenum intake (in food, drink and ALXN1840), and molybdenum output (feces and urine) representing ALXN1840 steady state

endpoints.name: Safety Endpoint _ Vital Signs
endpoints.text: Vital sign assessments (blood pressure and heart rate)

objectives.name: Secondary Molybdenum Accumulation Objective
objectives.text: Assess accumulation of molybdenum with ALXN1840 treatment at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Molybdenum Accumulation Endpoint
endpoints.text: Accumulation of molybdenum as determined by molybdenum balance

objectives.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Objective
objectives.text: Determine the steady_state plasma pharmacokinetic (PK) of total molybdenum and plasma ultrafiltrate (PUF) molybdenum (as surrogate measures of ALXN1840, 15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Endpoint
endpoints.text: PK parameters for plasma total and PUF_molybdenum

objectives.name: Safety and Tolerability Objective
objectives.text: Evaluate the safety and tolerability of repeated_dose administration of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Safety Endpoint _ TEAEs and SAEs
endpoints.text: Treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs)/serious adverse events (SAEs)

objectives.name: Exploratory Dose Response Objective
objectives.text: Determine dose response of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day for copper balance in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Exploratory Dose Response Endpoint
endpoints.text: Assess dose response of ALXN1840 on copper balance focusing on copper balance

objectives.name: Exploratory Treatment Duration Objective
objectives.text: Determine the effect of treatment duration on copper balance in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Exploratory Treatment Duration Endpoint
endpoints.text: Determine the effect of time following initiation of ALXN1840 treatment on copper balance

objectives.name: Exploratory Ceruloplasmin and Copper Profiles Objective
objectives.text: Assess the effects of ALXN1840 on ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin_bound copper LBC profiles in plasma in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Exploratory Ceruloplasmin and Copper Profiles Endpoint
endpoints.text: Ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin_bound copper, and LBC: Change in ceruloplasmin at Days 1, 8, 25, 29, 36, and Day 39 compared with predose

estimands.name: Primary Copper Balance Estimand _ ALXN1840 15mg/day
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study who receive ALXN1840 15 mg/day during inpatient periods with controlled diet and complete copper balance collection periods (All Enrolled Participants (Full Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Mean daily copper balance (mg/day) with descriptive statistics; net copper balance (negative indicating decoppering).

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption due to safety concerns
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 15 mg/day due to meeting dose modification criteria before completion of the copper balance collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before collection period completion
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing the required copper balance collection period at 15 mg/day

intercurrentEvents.name: Outpatient period extension (Primary Copper Balance Estimand _ ALXN1840 15mg/day)
intercurrentEvents.text: Outpatient period (Day 9 to Day 23) is extended up to an additional 14 days per adaptive protocol feature, potentially altering the timing of steady_state assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Participant remains on 15 mg/day for full study duration
intercurrentEvents.text: Due to safety concerns, participant does not escalate to 30 mg/day and remains on 15 mg/day for the entire study duration

intercurrentEvents.name: Dietary non_compliance during inpatient period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant deviates from the copper_controlled diet during the inpatient collection period, affecting copper intake measurements

estimands.name: Secondary Copper Balance Change Estimand _ 15 mg/day vs Baseline
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease who complete the pretreatment baseline collection period (Days _4 through _1) and at least one ALXN1840 15 mg/day collection period (All Enrolled Participants (Full Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Change from baseline in mean daily copper balance (mg/day) with descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, median, range).

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption during 15 mg/day period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption before completing the 15 mg/day collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete baseline collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not complete the full 4_day pretreatment baseline collection period (Days _4 through _1)

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation (Secondary Copper Balance Change Estimand _ 15 mg/day vs Baseline)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing the ALXN1840 15 mg/day collection period

estimands.name: Secondary Copper Disposition Estimand
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study who receive ALXN1840 15 mg/day and/or 30 mg/day and have copper disposition samples collected (All Enrolled Participants (Full Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, median, minimum, maximum) for copper concentrations and amounts in each compartment (food, drink, feces, urine, plasma total copper, LBC) by dose and collection period.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption (Secondary Copper Disposition Estimand)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption before completing the copper disposition collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete sample collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant has incomplete feces, urine, food, or blood sample collection during the collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation (Secondary Copper Disposition Estimand)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing the copper disposition collection period

estimands.name: Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Estimand
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study who receive ALXN1840 15 mg/day and/or 30 mg/day and have molybdenum disposition samples collected at steady state (All Enrolled Participants (Full Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, median, minimum, maximum) for molybdenum concentrations and amounts in each compartment (food, drink, feces, urine, plasma) at steady state by dose.

intercurrentEvents.name: Steady state not achieved
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant has not achieved pharmacokinetic steady state at the time of the molybdenum disposition collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption before steady state
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption before achieving steady state and completing the molybdenum disposition collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation (Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Estimand)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing the molybdenum disposition collection period at steady state

estimands.name: Secondary Molybdenum Balance Estimand
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study who receive ALXN1840 15 mg/day and/or 30 mg/day and have complete molybdenum intake and output data at steady state (All Enrolled Participants (Full Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Mean daily molybdenum balance (mg/day) with descriptive statistics; neutral balance (molybdenum in = molybdenum out) indicating steady state achievement.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption at steady state
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption during the steady_state molybdenum balance collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete molybdenum collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant has incomplete feces, urine, food, or ALXN1840 dose data during the steady_state collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation (Secondary Molybdenum Balance Estimand)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing the molybdenum balance collection period at steady state

estimands.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Estimand _ Plasma Total and PUF_Molybdenum
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study who receive ALXN1840 15 mg/day and/or 30 mg/day and have adequate PK samples collected at steady state (PK Analysis Population (all participants with at least one evaluable PK sample)) Summary measure: Non_compartmental PK parameters including AUC, Cmax, Cmin, Tmax, t1/2, and clearance; descriptive statistics by dose level.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption before PK sampling
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption before the scheduled steady_state PK sampling timepoints

intercurrentEvents.name: Missed or incomplete PK samples
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant has missing or inadequate PK blood samples at scheduled timepoints

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before PK assessment

soaFootnotes.label: f
soaFootnotes.text: Discharge from the unit may occur after completion of all procedures on Day 9 and on Day 40 and after the Investigator has reviewed all safety assessment (including safety laboratory tests) and confirmed that the participant is appropriate for discharge.

soaFootnotes.label: g
soaFootnotes.text: A single outpatient visit or phone call and safety laboratory assessment should occur between Day 14 and Day 18. A phone call may take place on a different day than the blood draw within the Day 14 through Day 18 period.

soaFootnotes.label: i
soaFootnotes.text: Parameters include age and sex. Race and ethnicity will be collected where permitted by local regulations.

soaFootnotes.label: j
soaFootnotes.text: Wilson disease history will include diagnosis date, method of diagnosis, history of cirrhosis, details of any previous liver biopsies performed, and treatment received.

soaFootnotes.label: k
soaFootnotes.text: A full physical examination will be performed at Screening, at check_in for the study, and at the End of the study/Early Termination Visit. A physical examination should also be performed on any participants with ongoing adverse events prior to discharge from the unit. Otherwise, a symptom_driven physical examination may be performed at other times, at the Principal Investigator's discretion.

soaFootnotes.label: m
soaFootnotes.text: While in the CRU, study intervention will be administered after an overnight fast (ie, at least 10 hours) at the same time every morning; drug is to be administered with 240 mL of water and meals should be delayed a minimum of 2 hours after dosing. As an outpatient, participants are expected to take ALXN1840 at approximately the same time daily (+/_1 hour). Participants should take the medication with a glass of water on an empty stomach; meals should be delayed a minimum of 2 hours after dosing.

soaFootnotes.label: n
soaFootnotes.text: During the outpatient period, participants will use SMS text messaging to confirm study intervention administration.

soaFootnotes.label: p
soaFootnotes.text: PK/PD collection will include timepoints described in the schedule of PK/PD assessment for Days 1, 25, 29, and 39 (Table 2).

soaFootnotes.label: q
soaFootnotes.text: Samples for serum chemistry will be obtained following a fast of at least 8 hours at the Screening Visit and at check_in. In case of rechecks, and postdose serum chemistry, participants may not have fasted for 6 or 8 hours before the serum chemistry sample is taken.

soaFootnotes.label: r
soaFootnotes.text: Laboratory assessment including chemistry, hematology, and coagulation parameters should be performed on Days _8, _1, 8, 23, and 28 only.

soaFootnotes.label: s
soaFootnotes.text: Menstruation check for women only; women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening. Additional urine pregnancy testing will be standard for the protocol unless serum testing is required by site policies, local regulation, or Institutional Review Boards (IRBs)/Independent Ethics Committees (IECs) (Section 10.2). In addition to pregnancy tests detailed at the visits in the SoA, females of childbearing potential will be required to perform urine pregnancy tests at least every 4 weeks at their home or the study site throughout their time in the study.

soaFootnotes.label: t
soaFootnotes.text: A single 15 mL serum sample will be retained for evaluation in the event of an unexpected safety finding; retained samples may be destroyed after completion of the clinical study report.

soaFootnotes.label: u
soaFootnotes.text: Vital signs measurements and ECGs should be performed predose, unless otherwise specified. Vitals signs include body temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, and systolic and diastolic blood pressure.

soaFootnotes.label: v
soaFootnotes.text: Copper_ and molybdenum_controlled diet will be initiated after registration/inclusion. Participants will remain on a copper/molybdenum controlled diet throughout both the inpatient Period 1 (Day _8 to Day 9) and inpatient Period 2 (Day 23 to Day 40); during this time participants will be strongly encouraged to complete all meals. While not in the CRU, participants will be encouraged to adhere to their usual copper_controlled diet.

soaFootnotes.label: w
soaFootnotes.text: For each input/output balance period, 24_hour urine samples are to be collected for measurement of copper and molybdenum.

soaFootnotes.label: x
soaFootnotes.text: For fecal samples, each individual sample will be independently collected with record of date, time, and weight of the sample.

plannedDuration.reasonDurationWillVary: Duration depends on individual subject progression and follow-up.

eligibilityCriteria.name: Ability to comply with study procedures
Willingness to adhere to controlled diet
Decompensated cirrhosis or high MELD score
Active viral infection or HIV seropositivity
Significant medical history or current disorder
Known sensitivity to ALXN1840 or excipients
History of illicit drug or significant alcohol abuse
Recent alcohol consumption or positive alcohol breath test
Unwillingness to complete every meal and tolerate controlled menu

notes.text: This amendment is considered to be substantial based on the criteria set forth in Article 10(a) of Directive 2001/20/EC of the European Parliament and the Council of the European Union, the US Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) regulation at 21 CFR part 312.30(b), and any applicable local regulations.

The main reason for preparation of this amendment was to clarify study procedures occurring across different sites in the US, so as to facilitate participant recruitment across different regions of the US, and to lessen inconvenience for participants without compromising the quality of the study.
Addition of text to the footnote to state that procedures specific to screening sites (only in the US) detailed in Section 8. Rationale: As per Section 8 (below).

Number of days changed from 30 days to 21 days: the inhibitory effect of zinc on intestinal copper absorption is expected to be minimal 30→21 days after discontinuation of zinc. Rationale: To align the number of days with the mention of zinc discontinuation elsewhere in the protocol.

Addition of text applicable only to the US that details the possibility for sites in the US to only perform screening procedures and not any of the remaining study procedures. Rationale: To facilitate participant recruitment across different regions of the US and to lessen inconvenience for participants without compromising the quality of the study.
Abbreviations: ALT = alanine aminotransferase; AST = aspartate aminotransferase; IB = Investigator's Brochure; PK = pharmacokinetics; WD = Wilson disease.

The COVID_19 pandemic is active at the time of this protocol amendment. Given this unique circumstance, specific consideration has been given to the potential risks and mitigation measures due to COVID_19 vaccine (see Section 10.5).
A cannula may be placed to minimize needle sticks; however, a catheter may not be left in place for longer than 72 hours and should be flushed a minimum of every 8 hours.

Participants may be discharged from the CRU on Day 9 and return on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose); all procedures will start on Day 23. To ensure flexibility, the Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval.
During the Outpatient Period, participants will use SMS text messaging to confirm study intervention administration.
At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the outpatient period for safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol.

The intra_patient dose escalation schedule is similar to that employed in the current Phase 3 Study WTX101_301. The similar schedule was chosen to characterize the decoppering effects expected early with treatment.
Limited nonclinical data on copper elimination with tetrathiomolybdate suggested copper excretion may be at least maintained or increased with repeated dosing (refer to the current IB).
Abbreviations: CRF = case report form; CRU = clinical research unit; EOS = End of Study; SoA = Schedule of Activities.
Rescreened participants are not required to reconsent as long as they have signed the latest version of the ICF.

If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to changes from baseline in QT interval corrected using Fridericia's formula [QTcF]) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study.

Blood pressure and heart rate measurements should be preceded by at least 5 minutes of rest for the participant in a quiet setting without distractions (eg, television, cell phones). Ideally, the same arm for each participant should be used for measurements.

If vital signs are abnormal as defined by inclusion/exclusion criteria, 2 additional vital signs measurements will be made. The average of the 3 vital signs measurements will be recorded in the CRF and used to determine participant eligibility.
As with vital signs, if ECG interval measurements are abnormal, an additional triplicate will be performed and recorded in the CRF.

All laboratory tests with values considered abnormal and clinically significant during participation in the study or after the last dose of study intervention should be repeated until the values return to normal or baseline or are no longer considered clinically significant by the Investigator or Medical Monitor.

All SAEs will be recorded and reported to Alexion or the designee immediately and under no circumstance should this exceed 24 hours. The Investigator will submit any updated SAE data to Alexion within 24 hours of it being available.
Open_ended and non_leading verbal questioning of the participant is the preferred method to inquire about AE occurrences.
Suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions (SUSARs) must be reported according to local regulatory requirements and Alexion policy and forwarded to Investigators as necessary.

A single biobanked serum sample will be collected predose from each participant to serve as a retained sample during the study. Samples will remain on site and will be discarded following the completion of the clinical study report. The sample will not be used for genetic testing.

For this study, any dose of ALXN1840 greater than that specified in the protocol will be considered an overdose. Alexion does not recommend specific treatment for an overdose. Overdoses are medication errors that are not considered AEs unless there is an untoward medical occurrence resulting from the overdose.
Samples collected within ± 10% or 30 min, whichever is less, of the scheduled time will not be considered a protocol deviation.

Excess/additional samples may be stored for up to 5 years and used for PD and/or diagnostic biomarker development and research to understand the pathways associated with the mechanism of action of ALXN1840. These samples will not be used for genetic analyses (ie, RNA or DNA analyses).
As this study is an exploratory study, no formal hypothesis testing is being conducted. Study results will be summarized using descriptive statistics.
Medical Monitor Name and Contact Information can be found in the Study Contact List.

Darwich, 2014 _ referenced in support of the physiologic turnover of human gastrointestinal epithelial cells being 3_5 days, used to justify the change from 30 to 21 days for zinc discontinuation effect.

studyInterventions.name: ALXN1840
studyInterventions.description: bis_choline tetrathiomolybdate (formerly WTX101), a novel copper binding agent for the treatment of Wilson disease. Administered as 15 mg/day for approximately 28 days (Day 1 through Day 28), then titrated to 30 mg/day from Day 29 through Day 39.

studyInterventions.name: Paracetamol/acetaminophen
studyInterventions.description: Permitted for use as an exception with Investigator approval, limited to a maximum of 1000 mg per day.

studyInterventions.name: Ibuprofen
studyInterventions.description: Permitted with caution as a CYP2C9 substrate; dose must not exceed 1200 mg in any 24_hour period and may only be used with Investigator approval.

studyInterventions.name: Penicillamine
studyInterventions.description: Copper_chelating therapy (standard of care for Wilson disease) that must be discontinued starting on Day _4 prior to ALXN1840 initiation to allow baseline copper/molybdenum balance assessment.

studyInterventions.name: Trientine
studyInterventions.description: Copper_chelating therapy (standard of care for Wilson disease) that must be discontinued starting on Day _4 prior to ALXN1840 initiation to allow baseline copper/molybdenum balance assessment.

studyInterventions.name: Zinc therapy
studyInterventions.description: Must be discontinued at least 21 days prior to Day 1 (discontinued at Day _21). Zinc works through upregulation of metallothionein in enterocytes resulting in elevation of fecal copper excretion, which could confound study results.

studyInterventions.name: St John's wort / herbal remedies
studyInterventions.description: Disallowed; herbal remedies must be discontinued at least 7 days prior to first admission (or 2 weeks before first study intervention for St John's wort specifically) until study completion.

studyInterventions.name: Prescription medications
studyInterventions.description: Disallowed within 14 days or 5 half_lives (whichever is longer) of Day _7 unless specifically permitted. Nonprescription drugs (including vitamins and dietary or herbal supplements) disallowed within 7 days or 5 half_lives before Day _7 until follow_up visit completion, except as described in Section 6.5.1.

studyInterventions.name: Minerals containing copper, zinc, or molybdenum
studyInterventions.description: Disallowed throughout the study duration. Participants must avoid use of minerals containing copper, zinc, or molybdenum.

studyInterventions.name: Experimental or unapproved/unlicensed therapy
studyInterventions.description: Disallowed; must not have been used within 90 days or 5 half_lives (whichever is longer) prior to the Screening Visit.

studyInterventions.name: Previous ALXN1840 or other tetrathiomolybdate
studyInterventions.description: Disallowed; previous treatment with ALXN1840 or other form of tetrathiomolybdate within 1 year prior to dosing is an exclusion criterion.
